_provenance.description: CPI (Consumer Price Index) reference tables used to compute inflation multipliers for Public Accounts of Canada dollar figures.
_provenance.source: Statistics Canada, Table 18-10-0004-01 (Consumer Price Index, monthly, not seasonally adjusted)
notes: cpi_inflation_indexes is keyed by Government of Canada fiscal year (FY ending year; FY2017 = Apr 2016-Mar 2017), using avg_cpi averaged over the fiscal year's available months.
calendar_cpi_inflation_indexes is keyed by calendar year, using avg_cpi averaged over the calendar year's available months.
months_count records how many months of CPI data were available for that year (partial for the most recent year).
index_YYYY columns are multipliers to convert that row's-year dollars into YYYY dollars: amount_in_YYYY_dollars = amount * index_YYYY.
Example: fiscal_year 2017 row's index_2023 value multiplies FY2017 dollars up to FY2023 dollars.

cpi_inflation_indexes.description: One row per Government of Canada fiscal year (ending year convention).
